voiceover_script.text: Welcome to the world of AI, where technology meets human rights.
AI is transforming our world, but with great power comes great responsibility.
But as AI advances, concerns about human rights and privacy grow.
But what do people think about the impact of AI on human rights?
Experts weigh in on the need for regulation and transparency.
So what can be done to address these concerns?
The future of AI and human rights depends on our ability to work together.
